title: Brian Kernighan and Ken Thompson
alt: Brian Kernighan (left), with white hair, a short beard and a grey sweater, and Ken Thompson (right), bald, with glasses, a long white beard and a black T-shirt, sit side by side at a table on a stage in front of a blank screen.
author: A.C.Diller
description: VCF East 2019 -- Brian Kernighan interviews Ken Thompson. This talk took place May 4, 2019.
